metadata.title: Covariant Calculus and Hamiltonian Flows for Nonlocal Wasserstein Metrics
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we study nonlocal metrics on smooth positive probability densities on a closed manifold, induced by symmetric jump kernels and density-dependent mobilities. First, we introduce the density-variation operator to express the density derivatives of the Dirichlet form and kinetic energy. Second, we construct density and velocity-field representations of the tangent space and prove their isometric equivalence. We use the generator's pseudoinverse to derive Levi-Civita connections and covariant differentials in both representations. Third, we establish mechanical Hamiltonian dynamics in both tangent representations; an action principle and Legendre duality identify the Hamilton--Jacobi and covariant Newton equations; smooth negative gradient flows admit a zero-energy Hamiltonian lift. Entropy diffusion, nonlocal mean-field equations, Keller--Segel dynamics, and a nonlocal Vlasov equation illustrate the resulting calculus. For geometric-mean mobility, the Hopf--Cole transformation of the nonlocal Schrödinger bridge system and the Madelung transformation of the nonlocal Schrödinger equation yield hyperbolic and trigonometric phase energies, respectively. At zero momentum, both recover the metric kinetic energy to second order.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: 非局部最优输运的协变微积分
analysis.workSummary: 在闭流形的光滑正概率密度空间上，以对称跳跃核及密度依赖mobility定义非局部度量。建立密度变分算子、密度与速度场两种切空间的等距表示，并借生成元伪逆导出Levi-Civita联络和协变微分。以作用量和Legendre对偶建立机械Hamilton动力学、Hamilton–Jacobi及协变Newton方程，光滑负梯度流有零能量Hamilton提升。几何平均mobility下Schrödinger桥的Hopf–Cole及Schrödinger方程的Madelung变换给双曲/三角相位能量，零动量处二阶恢复度量动能。
techniques: 生成元伪逆与切空间等距表示
analysis.breakthrough: 为非局部Wasserstein型度量提供统一协变动力学，并解释扩散和场方程的几何形式。
analysis.limitations: 工作于光滑正密度及满足要求的核/mobility，摘要不提供弱解存在或奇异密度完备化定理。零动量仅二阶恢复，不是全动量相位能量与度量动能恒等。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
